# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old in Volume 2  <sub>[v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c18 P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004), [v2 c23 P22](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0022)</sub>
- **Origin:** United States (Boston)  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** School student  <sub>[v1 c29 P0](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0000), [v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric has a delicate, refined face framed by chestnut curls, exceptionally dark blue eyes, and crimson lips. Though he is small for his age, he is handsome and possesses an extraordinarily bright, responsive smile.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c15 P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012)_

## Personality

Cedric is a thoughtful, imaginative, and sensitive boy with a deep, poetic soul. He is polite, earnest, and deeply affectionate toward those he trusts, often sharing his whimsical daydreams and rich inner world. Despite his dreamy nature, he is capable, manly, and well-liked by his peers.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P33](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0033), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c5 P22](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0022), [v2 c19 P11](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0011)_

- Highly imaginative and poetic  <sub>[v2 c19 P11](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- To please his grandmother and teacher  <sub>[v1 c18 P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037), [v2 c19 P12](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0012)</sub>

## History

Cedric Stanhope was born in the United States and lost his mother when he was three years old. He was raised by his father, Stephen Stanhope, in Boston until he was sent to live with his grandmother on St. Brendan's Island in Brierley. There, he attended the Brierley school under Nell Harcourt. During a winter night when Posy Fay Pembroke fell ill with croup, Cedric ran to Brierley to summon help and assisted Nell in nursing the child through the night. Later, when Nell fell ill with a severe ankle injury, Cedric visited her faithfully and comforted her. In school, he proved to be an intelligent and popular student who formed a special bond of kindred friendship with Nell, sharing his whimsical daydreams with her.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c23 P21](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0021), [v1 c23 P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c5 P22](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0022), [v2 c15 P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 c19 P11](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0011), [v2 c19 P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015)_

## Quotes

> I ask you to take these, teacher, which I discovered in the field belonging to Mr. Duckett, and I returned so I could offer them to you since I believed you were a lady who would appreciate them, and also because... teacher, I am fond of you.  <sub>[v2 c5 P22](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0022)</sub>

> Mrs. Sowerby, father made a pretty good job of picking out my first mother and I could trust him to pick out just as good a one the second time.  <sub>[v1 c19 P23](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0023)</sub>

> You understand, teacher. My belief is that Miss Rosalind would not force a boy to consume breakfast porridge against his preference. She would provide him with foods he enjoyed instead.  <sub>[v1 c19 P18](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0018)</sub>

> I’m no gemplum.  <sub>[v2 c8 P19](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0019)</sub>
